# 歷朝釋氏資鑑

**ID:** X1517
**Volume:** X76
**Category:** 史傳部類
**Original Category:** 史傳部／編年通史
**Byline:** 元 熙仲集
**Dynasty:** 元
**Date:** 1271–1368
**Juans:** 12
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X1517

## Contributors
- 熙仲 (A001627)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A Yuán-dynasty Buddhist universal history in twelve juan, compiled by the monk [熙仲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%86%99%E4%BB%B2) (Xīzhòng) and dated by his preface to 1336 (Yuán *Zhìyuán* 至元 2 of the second Zhìyuán reign-period). The title — *zījiàn* 資鑑 ("mirror for reference") — places the work in the same Confucian-historiographical lineage as [本覺](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%AC%E8%A6%BA)'s [KR6r0020](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0020), i.e. as a Buddhist analogue to the *Zīzhì tōngjiàn* of [司馬光](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%B8%E9%A6%AC%E5%85%89). Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* (X76 no. 1517).

**Abstract**

[熙仲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%86%99%E4%BB%B2)'s preface explains that he undertook the compilation because the existing universal Buddhist histories — including [志磐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BF%97%E7%A3%90)'s [KR6r0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0012), [本覺](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%AC%E8%A6%BA)'s [KR6r0020](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0020), and [祖琇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A5%96%E7%90%87)'s [KR6r0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0017) — had become difficult to consult and inconsistent in their chronological coverage. His own twelve-juan work follows a strict year-by-year annalistic scheme, drawing imperial annals from the standard histories and inserting Buddhist events alongside.

The work covers from the Hàn through the early Yuán. Like [本覺](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%AC%E8%A6%BA)'s earlier *Tōngjiàn*, it adopts a relatively even-handed treatment of the Buddhist schools without obvious Tiāntái, Chán, or Pure Land bias. Its principal value is as a comparative source for events covered also by [KR6r0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0012), [KR6r0013](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0013), and [KR6r0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0014): where these works disagree, [熙仲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%86%99%E4%BB%B2)'s independent compilation provides a fourth witness.

[熙仲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%86%99%E4%BB%B2) himself is little documented beyond his preface. He was a Yuán-period monk active in the southern Buddhist establishment.
